name: LatLng
description: Forward and reverse geocoding, places search, autocomplete, static maps, and MapLibre-compatible vector map tiles powered by OpenStreetMap data. Includes a free developer tier with a generous daily quota.

endpoints.description: Forward geocoding — convert an address or place name to coordinates (GeoJSON)
Reverse geocoding — convert coordinates to the nearest address
Places search — discover OpenStreetMap points of interest by name or category
Static map image — render a PNG map for a given center, zoom, and size
